$comment: Latest published version of every THOL competitor that can run in this image, applied over THOL_REV by apply-competitor-pins.py. Upstream THOL pins the versions it last ran (2026-06/07); a board that measures stale competitors is not a fair board. Bumping any entry starts a new campaign, exactly as bumping THOL_REV does. Only the competitors THOL marks verified (plus claude-context and claude-mem, which install by version) are listed: the unverified entries track `main` and are not run. Each `replace` pair is [old, new], applied in order with word boundaries; `count` is how many replacements the file must take, so an upstream change that moves a pin fails the build instead of leaving a stale version in place.

headroom.$comment: headroom 0.44.0 dropped the -p short form of --port. Left alone, `headroom wrap claude -p ${PORT} --` forwards -p to claude, which then takes the port number as its prompt: the agent never sees the task (captured 2026-11-14). So the flag is rewritten along with the version.
